title: Physicist friend sees boulder pushed into a tree at the Roswell site

tellings.quote: I went I went to, you know, the Roswell site and I saw that a boulder had clearly been pushed into a what was probably a sapling at the time.

plain: At the site in New Mexico where a craft is said to have crashed near Roswell in 1947, a boulder appears to have been shoved into what was probably a young tree at the time. Michels says he went to the site and saw this himself. He offers it as possible physical trace of a heavy impact there.
